# JSBSim 1.3.1 scoped rights evidence

Reviewed 2026-10-03 for issue #13. Upstream commit `3b25f25e49b42d0489c04ac805674fc1450ca579`; acquisition ZIP SHA-256 `df57467a831cfa3ee3cadcb98d8291ce56bb11976e35dd9e93c94201ff1420d5` matches the independently acquired issue #12 lock. This evidence concerns the C++ library and named components, not the entire source archive or bundled model data.

XML blob `8f121c16eb81765b5ab672f80a4404e042fd179d` | Excluded, including unreviewed linked engine/system inputs. It cannot supply validated C172S coefficients or a manufacturer checklist |

The complete-header review corrected an initial concern based on the isolated historical GPL note. No component exclusion patch is needed on that basis. Preserve this evidence rather than perpetuating a blanket repository-level clearance or an unsupported GPL-only claim.

Separate technical limitation: coremag.cxx uses WMM2005 coefficients and documents their historic validity interval. Its presence in a numerical library does not make it the simulator's current geographic magnetic model. The world implementation must acquire/review WMM2025 coefficients/software and test vectors independently (WORLD-020 and the world source gate).

Release remains conditional. A filtered, reproducible library-only corresponding-source bundle must be reviewed and hashed independently of the acquisition ZIP. The packager must verify source completeness and DLL replacement, and stage the full applicable notices. Updating the dependency pin or compiled target reopens this scoped review.
